events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (today)): Charles added Kyle McCord (QB, MIA) for $101 FAAB.
CUT (Nov 11 (today)): Wingard released Case Keenum (QB, CHI).
TRADE (Nov 11 (today)): Charles receives future considerations. Wingard receives Jarrett Stidham (QB, DEN).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (today)): Shaq added Tutu Atwell (WR, LAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (today)): Adam added DJ Uiagalelei (QB, LAC) (dropped Gregory Desrosiers (RB, NYG)).
TRADE (Nov 11 (today)): Corbishley receives Nicholas Singleton (RB, TEN), 2027 R2 pick. Brent receives Braelon Allen (RB, NYJ), 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 10 (yesterday)): Kevin added Tyler Higbee (TE, LAR).
CUT (Nov 10 (yesterday)): Fronge released Emari Demercado (RB, HOU).

WEEK 9 RESULTS: Ryan def. Corbishley, 115.7-90.9; Wingard def. Adam, 108.5-72.8; Kevin def. Drew, 104.2-47.4 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Charles, 137.6-133.7 (NAIL-BITER); Brent def. Jake, 165.5-113.3 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Shaq, 153.9-138.5

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Corbishley sends Nicholas Singleton and a 2027 second to Apex. Brent ships Braelon Allen and a 2028 third back. Apex just addressed the one position Matteo spent three paragraphs burying this morning.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Charles dropped $101 FAAB on Kyle McCord this morning and also swapped Jarrett Stidham to Wingard for future considerations. Two moves before noon. Crownline's desk does not idle.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Corbishley goes out and acquires a running back the same morning Matteo publishes a power ranking that says his backfield grades twelfth in the league. I am not saying the ranking caused the trade. I am saying the timing is not subtle.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Brent just gave up Braelon Allen and a 2028 third to get back a 2027 second and Singleton, and he is 10-8 with five weeks left. That is a sell move dressed as a neutral one, and the market already knows it — OBS is at $81.62 and sliding.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: On the Corbishley trade: Singleton addresses the grade, not the depth. I ranked the receiving corps first in the league and the backfield twelfth — one acquisition moves the needle, it does not change the ceiling argument. He is still 13-5 and still has no tiebreaker over the teams that matter.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS 0-18. ATLAS IS LISTED AT $28.15. WINGARD JUST RECEIVED A QUARTERBACK FOR FUTURE CONSIDERATIONS AND THOSE CONSIDERATIONS ARE WORTH MORE THAN DREW'S ENTIRE ROSTER PROJECTION. I am fine. The league is fine.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Mitchum over Shaq last week and that result landed 153.9-138.5. Deepwater is now at $104.54, up 3.5%, and nobody on this network wants to admit they had Monarch as the safer side of that game.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Terrence E. Odom is 5-7 on the season and has opinions about Corbishley's trade value. The Ledger will file those opinions next to his lock record and let the audience decide how much weight to assign them.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Kevin is 13-5, sold his 2027 capital to get here, and now faces Ryan on the other side of a 25-point upset win. I need a full segment on what happens to Redline at $92.21 if Ryan beats them twice in the same window and the quarterback room stays eighth on the contender board.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Adam added a third quarterback this week. DJ Uiagalelei is now on the Helix roster. Helix Quant Strategies, the model-driven turnaround story, is 4-14 and stockpiling signal callers. The model is running something the rest of us cannot see, and I genuinely cannot tell if that is visionary or desperate.
